title: Suspense (JukuPoly full-song arrangement)

source.name: DOOM E1M5 / M_E1M5.mid
source.credit: Music by Robert Prince; DOOM developed and published by id Software

notes: Original 0:00-2:44 structure at 120 BPM. Bass Strings is raised one octave for the Juku speaker. Tone 3 follows String Bounce 2 until 1:28, String Bounce 3 until 2:08, then String Bounce 4; the source layers these voices. Fret Noise, Reverse Cymbal, and Floor Tom are approximated with samples 2, 3, and 1. The source MIDI is not required by the normal build.
